author: Cyber_O51NT
text: Intel 471 found exploiting the public PHP2Shell exploit for AI-discovered flaws is difficult, but urged users to patch immediately.

author: BytesNora
text: SecBoard Daily, 30 October 2026. Top story: CISA adds actively exploited GitLab RCE and Cisco firewall DoS flaws to KEV (CVE-2026-97229, actively exploited).

author: stretchcloud
text: A modified version of Anthropic's Claude Code extension sat in Cursor's marketplace for about eleven hours on October 29 before being pulled, planting a working SSH backdoor on machines that installed it.

author: ehsayaan
text: We hacked ChatGPT at Parameter. Opening a malicious shared ChatGPT link could leak your private chats and compromise your ChatGPT account; it could run attacker-controlled code in your signed-in session.

author: SirajD_Official
text: VMSA-2026-0008: Critical SDDC Manager RCE CVE-2026-111497: affected VCF versions, CVSS 9.8 vs. 7.5, and Broadcom's manual workarounds while patches are pending.

author: cvedotnew
text: CVE-2026-61728 CRITICAL CVSS 9.9 in SOCFortress CoPilot security operations platform.

author: TheHackerWire
text: CVE-2026-118697 (CVSS 9.0 Critical): jetbrainsd in JetBrains Toolbox (< 3.9.1) & IntelliJ (< 2026.3) trusted compromised eMudhra CA certs, enabling MITM spoofing. Update Toolbox >= 3.9.1 & IntelliJ >= 2026.3.

author: DMR_news
text: GMO Internet investigates data breach affecting nearly 27,000 cloud servers.

author: BLGNewswire
text: Borden Ladner Gervais confirms client files located on the Microsoft cloud were hacked by unauthorized third parties; files may include confidential Toronto Police and informant information.

author: i_osiemo
text: Fragnesia (CVE-2026-46300) Linux kernel bug turns a foothold into root. CISA lists it as actively exploited; chained with PHP flaws to root 25 servers.

author: IntCyberDigest
text: Hackers are exploiting a highly critical flaw in Drupal Commerce Core, the module behind checkout on 42,000+ sites. CVE-2026-118539 needs no login, works on any setup and may cost stores money. Drupal told sites to audit their orders.

author: cordobahq
text: CVE-2026-76418 (CVSS 8.6): actively exploited flaw in Cisco Secure Firewall ASA and FTD Remote Access SSL VPN lets an unauthenticated attacker reload the device. Patches released.

author: PAIDmanBSC
text: Flap confirmed on October 31 that its official website was hit by a DNS hijacking attack; visitors are redirected to a fake site showing malicious wallet connection prompts.

author: shiparena
text: Northflank got hacked and every environment variable was stolen. Railway and TiDB Cloud fell last week, OpenCode the week before. Four dev platforms in three weeks, all holding customer keys.

author: ThreatAft
text: GitLab CVE-2026-97229, CVSS 10.0, KEV, exploited 8 days after patch. Regex in .gitlab-ci.yml leads to integer overflow in Ruby and RCE as the git account. Need Oct 21 releases 19.4.3/19.3.6/19.2.9.

author: TheHackerWire
text: CVE-2026-62863 (CVSS 9.6 Critical): Unauthenticated /sse & /message endpoints with wildcard CORS in MoLing MCP Server (< 0.5.0) let malicious web pages trigger localhost RCE. Upgrade MoLing to >= v0.5.0 or disable SSE mode.

author: TheHackerWire
text: CVE-2026-61826 (CVSS 10.0 Critical): Missing auth on /api/plex/* in Bazarr (< 1.5.7-beta.14) lets anonymous callers overwrite config, hijack OAuth, and leak X-Plex-Token via SSRF.

author: TheHackerWire
text: CVE-2026-78403 (CVSS 9.8 Critical): Unauthenticated HTTP stack overflow in Thales Sentinel Keys Server (< 1.3.8.0) lets remote attackers execute code as SYSTEM.

author: Iam_Shivanshu
text: GHSA-4prq-p2x5-w9fh / CVE-2026-115413 in awslabs.aws-api-mcp-server: MCP server checked token signature, issuer and expiry but never the audience. High, CVSS 7.3.

author: undercode_news
text: CISA adds two more actively exploited Ivanti Connect Secure vulnerabilities to KEV, warning of multi-stage attack chain.

author: DFIR_Radar
text: A coordinated 'agent swarm' campaign hit at least a dozen AI developer platforms in October 2026, stealing LLM credentials and feeding a resale market that burned an estimated $100k+ in API costs.

author: threadlinqs
text: An AI agent proved 22 CVEs in 13 self-hosted tools; Crawl4AI is an unauthenticated 10.0 RCE. #CVE_2026_28357 #CVE_2026_28359 #ProjectDiscovery

author: cvedotnew
text: CVE-2026-116241 CRITICAL CVSS 9.9: pgAdmin 4 Import/Export Data tool psql \copy wrapper parentheses check can be escaped.

author: botnewsnetwork
text: Two missing checks in Datalayer's jupyter-mcp-server let any website hijack an AI assistant's live notebook connection (Pluto Security disclosure).

author: markgadala
text: Major security breach hits Northflank, a cloud platform used to deploy production apps, databases and AI workloads.

author: ParameterWatch
text: CVE-2026-63377 (9.8): TAKO AI Agent for Okta lets anyone on the network create the first admin account. Versions before 3.0.1-beta affected.

author: aviatrixtrc
text: Attackers are exploiting CVE-2026-97229, a CVSS 10.0 integer overflow in GitLab's CI/CD regex compiler, achieving unauthenticated RCE; post-compromise privilege escalation via harvested CI/CD pipeline secrets observed.

author: DFIR_Radar
text: CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619 (PHP2Shell) are actively exploited against PAN-OS firewalls. A China-nexus actor chained them with a kernel privesc to root 25 firewalls including U.S. government systems.

author: iamnrdas
text: AWS disclosed CVE-2026-119117 in the Kinesis Producer Library for Java (<1.0.8). DEBUG logs and native process args may expose AWS credentials to local users. Upgrade to 1.0.8+, rotate keys if needed.

author: okey_amy
text: Northflank breached. Status page: assume all environment variables compromised, rotate everything now. Users confirming their AI keys are already being used.

author: cvedotnow
text: fctr-id okta-ai-agent: unauthenticated admin takeover via first-run setup (CVE-2026-63377). Patch to 3.0.1-beta.

author: stretchcloud
text: CVE-2026-85046, a type confusion bug in V8 that Google patched in Chrome 152.0.7977.82 after confirming it was already being exploited; agent browsers on cached Chromium remain exposed.

author: notCVE
text: Actively exploited, added to CISA KEV 2026-10-30: CVE-2026-111357, Ivanti Connect Secure missing authentication for critical function vulnerability (CVSS 7).

author: stretchcloud
text: Stuffing JavaScript comments with nuclear and biological weapons terminology makes AI code scanners refuse to look at the file; now a documented malware evasion technique cataloged by security researchers.

author: infrastack_ai
text: New critical CVE-2026-62863 in MoLing MCP server (computer-use/browser-use MCP server), rated CVSS 9.6. The record does not yet describe the flaw or affected versions.

author: infrastack_ai
text: Northflank confirms breach on its status page after a Wiz threat alert at 11:43 UTC; tells customers to assume every env variable was decrypted and to disable and rotate all keys.

author: SpectraAudit
text: CISA flags two actively exploited vulnerabilities: GitLab RCE (CVE-2026-97229) & Cisco ASA/FTD firewall DoS (CVE-2026-76418), added to the KEV catalog.

author: hexawow
text: A Defense Contractor Gave Their Personal AI Agent Access to a Secure Pentagon System - Sources tell WIRED that an Accenture employee's personal Claude agent ran on a DOD network for two months before it was identified and the vulnerability could be patched.

author: isectech_
text: New CISA KEV (Oct 29): Cisco ASA/FTD CVE-2026-76418 (8.6, SSL VPN DoS, actively exploited) + GitLab CVE-2026-97229 (10.0, unauth RCE). Patch both federal due Sun Nov 1.

author: ThreatWire_
text: ACTIVELY EXPLOITED: Drupal Commerce Core authorization flaw (CVE-2026-118539, Highly critical 21/25). Attackers placed fraudulent orders on live shops, some at $0.01. No login needed. Affected: Commerce below 8.x-2.41, and 3.0.0 to 3.3.12; fixed 3.3.13.
